title: UpdateTeamMemberRequest
description: UpdateTeamMemberRequest schema from AWS CodeStar API

allOf.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the user for whom you want to change team membership attributes.
The role assigned to the user in the project. Project roles have different levels of access. For more information, see Working with Teams in the AWS CodeStar User Guide.

Whether a team member is allowed to remotely access project resources using the SSH public key associated with the user's profile. Even if this is set to True, the user must associate a public key with their profile before the user can access resources.
